title: Keep federation fixture terminal diagnostics faithful after the first heartbeat
outcome: The shared federation attestation fixture preserves or explicitly documents the lifecycle of its satellite receiver so a fixture-only drop cannot masquerade as the link's first production terminal cause.
acceptance: A fixture-attested context does not silently consume its first terminal diagnostic through a receiver future dropped immediately after readiness; the fixture lifetime or its documented limitation makes this behavior explicit.
Relevant attestation fixture consumers retain real heartbeat readiness, exact context ownership and existing deadline/authority behavior.
